market_question: Will another country leave OPEC in 2026?
reasoning: UAE's April 2026 exit weakens OPEC, but another member officially leaving before year-end is unlikely. Past exits (Qatar, Ecuador, Angola) were isolated, and most major producers (Iraq, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia) gain more from staying. The market price of 31.5% seems elevated by recency bias; a 25% probability better reflects the limited near-term contagion risk.
evidence_points: Angola left OPEC in Dec 2023 without triggering further immediate exits.
Iraq's oil minister has repeatedly stated commitment to OPEC+ even when disagreeing over quotas.
Saudi Arabia would strongly discourage another exit, reducing the incentive for smaller Gulf or African members.
